clue.text: Deprived female lacking Basque headgear

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so one letter is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: deprived means bereft

explanation.surface: A deprived woman goes without the traditional cap of the Basque country.
explanation.definitionFit: A beret is the flat round woollen cap traditionally worn in the Basque region.

clue.text: Achieve independence, being autodidactic?

definitions.meaning: to become free of any boss or controller
a self-taught person is in effect their own teacher, a playful second sense of master

explanation.definitionFit: Being free of control means answering to nobody, and a self-taught person has served as their own schoolmaster.

clue.text: Clash over a hard Asian ruler

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the word is turned upwards, read backwards

parts.note: to clash is to jar
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A dispute over something difficult involving an Eastern potentate.
explanation.definitionFit: A rajah was an Indian prince or king, so an Asian ruler.

clue.text: Jazz fan raised hat that may perhaps be felt

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is lifted so it reads bottom to top

parts.note: cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast
tile is old slang for a hat

explanation.surface: A jazz lover lifts a hat that could perhaps be made of felt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns CAT into TAC. 'felt' looks like the hat's material, but it is the past tense of feel.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tactile can be perceived by touch, so it may be felt.

clue.text: Irrepressible soldiers I found in quiet setting

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a crossword stand-in for soldiers

indicators.note: found in means one piece is placed within another

parts.note: a quiet setting is a silent one

explanation.surface: Tough troops and I keep going in a hushed environment.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone resilient bounces back from setbacks, so cannot be kept down.

clue.text: Endlessly bemoaning downfall

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: bemoaning means ruing, lamenting

explanation.surface: Someone laments a fall from grace without stopping.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin is a collapse or downfall, as in the ruin of a great house.

clue.text: Decorous behaviour appears to cross boundaries

indicators.note: to cross here means to span across another piece, holding it inside

parts.note: appears means seems
lines are boundaries, as in drawing the line

explanation.surface: Proper conduct seems to be stepping over limits.
explanation.definitionFit: Seemliness is propriety, the quality of behaving decorously.

clue.text: Graduate wearing woven cloth is American footballer

indicators.note: wearing means the cloth surrounds the graduate like a garment

parts.note: linen is a cloth woven from flax
MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate

explanation.surface: A graduate dressed in fabric turns out to be a gridiron player.
explanation.definitionFit: A lineman is a player in the forward line in American football.

clue.text: Unconventional device for converting motion

definitions.meaning: a disc mounted off-centre on a shaft that turns rotation into back-and-forth movement

explanation.definitionFit: An odd person is called eccentric, and in engineering an eccentric is an off-centre wheel converting rotary motion.

clue.text: Existing exponents — those in authority?

definitions.meaning: exponents in maths are powers, and existing ones are those that be, archaic for that are

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom for the people in charge, and read literally it means powers that exist.

clue.text: Aim relating to external phenomena

definitions.meaning: concerning things outside the mind, as opposed to subjective

explanation.definitionFit: An objective is a goal, and objective also means dealing with real things outside one's own feelings.

clue.text: Mother-of-pearl container rejected by Egyptian god

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a can is a container
Re, also Ra, is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A vessel of pearly material is turned away by a deity of the Nile.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre is the iridescent lining of shells, also called mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: It's part of the choice like sound, on reflection

indicators.note: it is part of means the letters sit inside the following words

explanation.surface: A selection that sounds similar when you think it over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on reflection' looks like a reversal signal, but the letters read forwards; it belongs to the definition, since an echo is sound reflected.
explanation.definitionFit: Echoic means imitating or like an echo, which is sound bounced back.

clue.text: Loud beat once ruined Spanish dance

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical abbreviation for loud
to lam is to beat or thrash

indicators.note: ruined means the following word is wrecked and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A heavy loud rhythm once spoilt a dance from Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is the passionate Andalusian dance style with stamping and guitar.

clue.text: One-time flight of S African fellows in east of France

indicators.note: in means the fellows are placed inside the French word

parts.note: est is the French word for east
Cape men are men from the Cape, in South Africa

explanation.surface: Some South African men fled long ago to eastern France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'S African' is short for South African: the Cape is the Western Cape region, so its men are South Africans. 'One-time' marks the word as archaic in this sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Escapement is an archaic word for an escape, so a flight in former times.

clue.text: Slack time in which cricket sides traverse oceans

indicators.note: to traverse is to lie across, so the sides span the oceans with them between

parts.note: the off side is one half of a cricket field
the on side is the other half of a cricket field
oceans means seas

explanation.surface: During a quiet period cricket teams travel overseas on tour.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field is split into two halves, the off side and the on (or leg) side, the batter's two flanks.
explanation.definitionFit: The off season is the slack part of the year when business or sport is quiet.

clue.text: Reckless to dupe a famous flag captain

parts.note: to dupe someone is to fool them
Thomas Hardy was Nelson's flag captain on HMS Victory at Trafalgar

explanation.surface: It would be rash to trick a celebrated naval officer.
explanation.walkthrough: A flag captain commands an admiral's flagship; Hardy is the one of 'Kiss me, Hardy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Foolhardy means boldly rash, taking risks without sense.

clue.text: Bundle of fibres in cheek?

definitions.meaning: a cord of fibres carrying impulses through the body

explanation.definitionFit: Anatomically it is a bundle of fibres carrying signals, and colloquially it means brazen cheek.

clue.text: Racket has centre replaced by round loop

indicators.note: the middle letter of the word is swapped for another

parts.note: a racket is a din, noise
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A tennis racket's strings in the middle are swapped for a circular loop.
explanation.definitionFit: A noose is a loop of rope with a running knot.

clue.text: Terms of reference framed by East European recluse

indicators.note: framed by means surrounded on both sides

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for east
a remit is the set terms of reference for a task

explanation.surface: An Eastern European hermit is given formal instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: An eremite is a religious hermit, a recluse living apart.

clue.text: Purloins some of Kandinsky's paintings?

definitions.meaning: Kandinsky was a pioneer of non-representational art

explanation.definitionFit: To abstract is to remove or steal, and Kandinsky painted abstract works.

clue.text: Contrition about increasingly restricting son

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so one piece is enclosed

parts.note: increasingly suggests more and more
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Regret about increasingly holding back a boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse is deep regret for a wrong done, the same as contrition.

clue.text: Successful person a Greek character always follows

indicators.note: follows means the last piece comes after the earlier ones

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
ever means always

explanation.surface: A winner is someone a Greek figure constantly tails.
explanation.definitionFit: An achiever is someone who accomplishes things, a successful person.

clue.text: Waylay bishop during an Arctic journey with dogs

parts.note: an gives the letter A, the indefinite article

indicators.note: during means inside the time of, so the bishop sits within

parts.note: a mush is a journey by dog sled
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Ambushing a bishop while on a husky-sled trip across the Arctic.
explanation.definitionFit: To waylay is to lie in wait and attack, which is to ambush.

clue.text: Advocates quietly abandoning eliminatory processes

indicators.note: abandoning means the letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: purges are processes that get rid of things
P, piano, is the musical abbreviation for quietly

explanation.surface: Campaigners quietly give up on weeding-out methods.
explanation.definitionFit: Advocates as a verb means recommends or presses for, as urges does.

clue.text: Dam northern river, say

indicators.note: say means the word is spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: the Wear is a river in north-east England, flowing through Durham

explanation.surface: A barrier across a river in the north, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: A weir is a low dam built across a river to control its flow.

clue.text: It goes back a long time, inserted in subtropical headgear

indicators.note: inserted in means one piece goes inside the other
goes back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written before turning
an era is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A tradition dating back ages finds its way into a hat for hot climates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It goes back' makes TI; 'a long time' is the piece that is inserted, not part of the reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: A terai is a wide-brimmed felt hat worn in subtropical regions.

clue.text: The old bachelor due to join Eastern plant

parts.note: ye is an old form of the
a right is what one is due

explanation.surface: An old single man is about to join something in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyebright is a small wild flower once used to treat eye ailments.

clue.text: Her mystery mostly involved a mediocre poet

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are rearranged
mostly means all but the last letter is used

explanation.surface: Her detective story largely featured a second-rate versifier.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhymester is a writer of trivial verse, a poetaster.

clue.text: One initially accommodated by other woman

indicators.note: accommodated by means housed inside another piece

parts.note: else means other, as in someone else
one is I, the Roman numeral, and I is also the initial of initially

explanation.surface: One person is put up by a different lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Elsie is a woman's first name, a crossword stand-in for any woman.
